name: Retarded Field
description: A charge circles at 0.9 c (c = 1, Minkowski metric) in a uniform magnetic field from the fixed source at the center (the only particle with n = 1, and no charge). The arrows show the charge's retarded Coulomb field on a resting test charge: each point feels the charge where it was when the light now arriving left it, r/c ago, so the field lines bend into a spiral trailing the orbit. Clear Retarded on the Coulomb card (Forces) and every arrow snaps to the present position. Retarded Coulomb alone is not the full field of a moving charge: Dipole Antenna uses the Liénard–Wiechert preset.
